chunks: And said Al-Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him):
"Well-being is a hidden blessing; when it is found, it is forgotten, and when it is lost, it is remembered."
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of well-being (al-'afiyah) according to Imam Al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) characterizes 'al-'afiyah' as a subtle, pervasive blessing that escapes human notice due to its constant presence, a concept deeply rooted in Shia theological reflections on divine grace (ni'mah). This narration highlights the psychological phenomenon of 'neglect of the obvious,' urging believers to cultivate active gratitude (shukr) for health and safety before they are lost, thereby transforming passive existence into conscious worship.
